title: Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis: Evolution and Impact of Immunology in South America and the Caribbean
content: This systematic review and meta-analysis evaluates the evolution and scientific productivity of immunology in South America and the Caribbean from 2000 to 2025. Using PRISMA 2020 guidelines, 44 peer-reviewed studies were selected from indexed and regional databases. These studies reflect the thematic transition of immunology from infectious disease surveillance to personalised immunotherapies and systems biology. The meta-analysis confirmed exponential growth in publication trends (R² = 0.89) and thematic diversification. Contributions from both institutional centres and pioneering regional researchers were assessed. Heterogeneity (I² = 78%) among methodologies was reduced after sensitivity adjustment. The findings affirm that regional immunology is globally relevant and growing, though gaps remain in visibility, standardisation, and equity. Future directions include AI integration, vaccine equity, and immunogenomic mapping.
